newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RTZ-CRA sees Kennecott full capacity in June.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RTZ-CRA sees Kennecott full capacity in June.

text.p: Anglo-Australian mining and smelting group RTZ-CRA said on Thursday it aimed to have its Kennecott copper smelter in the United States running at full capacity around June.
"We are looking at around that time," RTZ-CRA chief executive Leon Davis told a news conference when asked if June was the target for full capacity at the smelter.
A planned six-week shutdown at the smelter is scheduled to begin in April, Davis said.
"It will happen in April. It will be about six weeks. It won't be a total stoppage of the smelter," he said.
Davis, speaking in a video conference from London, said earlier that most of the problems at the smelter had been fixed.
The company said the remaining problems were to increase capacity from the anode refining furnaces and redesign the casting wheel arrangement.
RTZ-CRA specifically referred to problems at the Kennecott smelter as a partial explanation for its fall in calendar 1996 net profit to US$1.096 billion from $1.441 billion in 1995.
Net profit at Kennecott fell to US$148 million in 1996 from $439 million in 1995.
